design_philosophy: Premium modern tech company aesthetic. Focus on high-end tech, trust, and clear curation. Emphasizes dark mode depth (#0D1117) with striking electric blue/cyan accents. NOT a dropshipping site, NO chaotic neon. Professional, sleek, and highly tactile with a focus on immersive product imagery.

headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large text. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for UI text, product descriptions, specs, and form inputs.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Gradients are only for subtle borders, badges, or primary CTA buttons.
Always use pure #0D1117 for the main app background to give a deep space tech feel.
Surface cards should use #2A2F36 with a 1px border of #2A2F36 or slightly lighter #3d444d to establish hierarchy.

surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass: bg-[#0D1117]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#2A2F36] shadow-sm.
surfaces.cards: Flat solid surfaces (bg-[#2A2F36]) with subtle 1px border. On hover, lift with -translate-y-1 and add a subtle glowing shadow of primary color (shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,119,255,0.15)]).
surfaces.bottom_nav: Crystal Glass for mobile app-like bottom navigation to ensure map/scroll content is visible underneath but text remains readable.

motion: Staggered entrance animations for product grids.
Hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, product cards).
Smooth layout transitions for drawer/cart sidebars using framer-motion.

layouts.general: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-12 for sections. Mobile-first design.
layouts.hero: Asymmetric bento grid or large immersive image with max overlay of bg-black/40. The product is the hero.
layouts.product_grid: Dense but clean grid. 1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 4 col desktop. Gap-6.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy. High density. Cards with subtle borders.
layouts.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar from 360px to 768px with badges for cart and favorites.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Primary button uses subtle cyan-to-blue gradient or solid #0077FF with hover:brightness-110.
components.product_card: Image dominates (bg-black rounded-t-lg). Includes discount badge (#E53E3E), favorite heart icon top right, category tag, product name, star rating, crossed old price, current price, and 'Comprar' button.
components.navigation: Top header on desktop (Logo, Links, Search, Icons). Bottom nav on mobile.
components.drawers: Use Shadcn Sheet for Cart, showing items, subtotal, shipping calculator, and checkout CTA.
components.icons: Use lucide-react (default) or Phosphor icons for a sharp technical look.

hero_product.description: Dark aesthetic premium drone for hero section or main banner.

category_laptops.description: Dark tech setup with RGB laptop for category or product card.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #F2F2F2 text meets APCA standards against #0D1117 and #2A2F36. For buttons, white text on #0077FF is compliant.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00C2FF] focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react` if not present. Use for all icons.
Install `framer-motion` for page transitions and micro-interactions.
Implement Shadcn UI components (Sheet for cart, Dialog for modals, Tabs for product specs, Dropdown for user menu).
Configure Tailwind with the provided color hex codes.
Use standard HTML structure but stylize with pure Tailwind. Build the layout responsively (360px up to 1440px).
In the admin panel, use Shadcn charts/Recharts for dashboard analytics.
Build the bottom mobile navigation as a fixed element on screens < 768px. Hide the standard desktop navbar links and use the bottom nav instead.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the curated image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or .jsx.
